services.name: ASA103 Basic Coastal Cruising (weekday) 3-day
services.desc: Rates Course Fee - $945 per Student Duration 3 days, 9am to 4pm About This intermediate sailing course is the next step up from the Basic Sailing (ASA 101) course. Do you want to charter a yacht in the Caribbean (or the Chesapeake)? Buy your own sailboat? Or do you just want to enjoy sailing on a larger, more comfortable yacht? This is the course for you. Advanced sailing skills aboard a larger sailing yacht (25 to 35 feet) with an inboard diesel engine. Skills include sail trim, docking, anchoring, sail reefing and coastal navigation. services.name: ASA104 Bareboat Cruising and option for IPC
services.desc: Rates Course Fee - $1225 Per Student Duration 3 days, live aboard. Arrive at 9am on day 1 and return to BaySail by 4pm on day 3 About This is our popular 3 day live-aboard class, cruising down the Chesapeake Bay. Two nights will be spent at anchor returning to BaySail on day 3. This advanced sailing course is for sailors looking for that certification recognized around the world enabling you to “act as skipper of crew of a 30 to 45 foot boat sailing by day in coastal waters.” Our ASA 104 Bareboat Cruising class has the option to apply for the International Proficiency Certification (IPC). The IPC is required by most European/Mediterranean charter companies as proof of your seamanship.

services.name: ASA 102 Boat Handling & Sail Trim Made Easy(2 Days)

includes: About this email: You are receiving this email because you provided us with your email address for updates.
Your class will run from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM and includes a one-hour lunch break.
Fee includes trial ASA membership and its benefits and discounts.
The test that comes with the course is great practice for the test that you are required to take at the end of our course.
Skills include sail trim, docking, anchoring, sail reefing and coastal navigation.
Time: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM (includes a one-hour lunch break) The course will be taught aboard our Hunter 33 sailboat by a certified ASA captain.
It will include both a practical on-the-water skills assessment and a written exam.
Your Charter Orientation will be provided the morning you arrive.
All taxes, fuel, boat and instructor are included in price.
